title: Outcomes and User Acceptance of the IntelliVue Alarm Advisor Software (Europe)
brief_summary: This Clinical Study will be conducted as a comparative study focusing on usability and efficiency by comparing alarm burden pre- and post-implementation of an "Alarm Advisor software".
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients admitted to the intensive care unit during the study period

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
